## PlaybackStatsPluginSettings type

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

Options for the [PlaybackStats](./player.playbackstats.md) plugin.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type PlaybackStatsPluginSettings = {
    reportInterval?: number;
};
```

## Remarks

The options are passed at the top level of the [player configuration](./player.playerconfig.md)<!-- -->, not nested under the plugin name.

- `reportInterval` - interval in milliseconds at which the stats report is sent while the playback is playing. Default is 5000.

## Example


```ts
Player.registerPlugin(PlaybackStats)
const player = new Player({
  sources: [...],
  reportInterval: 10000,
})
```
